text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, this is the flowerbed Air Groove-san
was talking about!
Alright, let's get right to it. Ikuno, are
you ready?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail. Air Groove-san is busy
dealing with the 'TCGC', so let us step in
and make sure the flowerbeds are
impeccably maintained in her stead."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've memorized all the procedures and
important points for today.
If you have any questions, please feel
free to ask me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, look at you, being all prepared and
responsible!
You really do love taking care of
everyone, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, Grandma taught me all about plant
care, so I'm probably better at it♪
Don't hesitate to lean on me if you need
help, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the ones who need to be
questioned are—
Hey, you lot! Get over here right this
instant!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Right away, sir!!
—Come on, Craft, don't zone out. Double
time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, I'm so sorry! The flowers Air
Groove-san grew were—
Th-they were just so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's the work of a Tiara-route
Legend, so of course
Craft couldn't resist! She never changes,
does she?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I believe this is no time for idle
chatter.
Heart-san, let us make haste as well."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
OK, OK!
And you're as stiff and serious as ever.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san, Cesario-san, Heart-san,
Messiah-san...
Alright, everyone is here. Shall we get to
work right away, then?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, excuse me...! So sorry for calling
out to you so suddenly! But
I just couldn't overlook such a brilliant
gathering of Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
By all means!! May we please conduct an
interview on your situation?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Heart-san. You came to grab the tools
for the flowerbeds, right?
Er, would you like us to help out...? Only
if you don't mind, of course!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, thanks♪
There was actually something I wanted to
ask you to do!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yay, getting close with Heart-san...
♡
Just say the word if you need anything!
We'll do our best.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Look at her popularity! Combined with
being an exchange student from America,
her aura of strength is off the charts. A
true "Queen"...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right then... Umph!
...And next is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright you two, listen up. That one over
there, and that other one...
And the box on top of the shelf! Could you
stack them all up on this? Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: THAT'S what you meant by helping?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that—she is actually remarkably
stoic and hard on herself!
Mmm, such a noble spirit... Truly a
captivating Umamusume!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... "Mix leaf mold, Akadama soil, and
black soil in roughly a 3:6:1 ratio."
"Adjust the proportions to achieve enough
moisture so it lightly clumps when
squeezed in hand"—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"The potting soil is ready on this side!
Good work.
I truly admire your steadfast and diligent
approach!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It's an honor.
Though I don't think I was able to offer
much of a flashy spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's more than enough! Still...
that attitude of yours
really does take after your mother so very
much, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? My mother is my guiding
light, so hearing that makes me even more
honored!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I intend to continue building upon this
steadily and surely moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as carefully prepared soil will
eventually nurture a glorious future.
I, too—someday, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Now, moving past Heart-san and
Messiah-san, we cannot overlook
these two classmates running the same
Tiara path—!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like I said~! Those flowers are delicate
to handle!
Didn't I tell you to just leave it to me!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, but still...! I came out here to take
care of the flowerbeds too!
I really want to be useful. Please, let me
do it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"......My apologies, Sweep-san. Craft is a
bit stubborn.
She and I will work together to proceed,
so would you mind leaving it to us this
once?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Sheesh, fine, I have no choice!
Instead, I'm gonna inspect you reaaal
strictly later. Prepare yourself!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thanks for earlier, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. Don't worry about it.
...I can tell well enough how pumped up
you are.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
B-But...! Air Groove-san asked me to help
Sweep-san and Ikuno-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
They're all seniors on the Tiara route
whom I deeply admire.
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't pumped up
for this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――The flowers are so pretty, aren't they?
Blooming in all sorts of colors... just
like our seniors!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to bloom like this too.
So radiantly that it leaves a lasting
impression in the heart of whoever sees
me!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
That earnestness of yours is truly—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, when it comes to my feelings for
the Tiara Umamusume, I will not be
outdone.
It is solely because of the history forged
by our great predecessors that we stand
here today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I too shall become a
cornerstone connecting history.
...As ones who admired the same era and
the same presence, let us duel.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I won't lose to Cesario...
or Messiah-san, or Heart-san either!
All right, I'm gonna do my best~!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how... how utterly magnificent!!
The brilliance of the Umamusume gracing
the glamorous stage of the Tiara
route...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uh, what's with him?
He's super worked up... Is this guy gonna
be okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"There shouldn't be any problem, likely.
Besides... I feel somewhat the same way as
Otonashi-san."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The stage of the Triple Tiara, where we
once raced.
I wonder what kind of drama those girls
will weave there—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. ...Well, I suppose?
I guess I could look forward to it, just a
little bit!
